description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures for Board Support Packages (BSP) related to i.MX boards, specifically for board 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi'. It includes functions to check images, perform upgrades, copy configs, and pre-upgrade steps, all conditioned on the board name.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata check for specific board 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi'.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is supported for the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for the current board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration for the current board before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade steps for the current board.
